summary: Iteration 43 — verified 4 new features: (1) Codex Descent Cinematic, (2) Cycle History Chart (backend + UI), (3) Marketplace Tier Filtering, (4) Simulator Audio toggle. Plus the 8 Post-Completion State cards on /codex. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases pass (new /app/backend/tests/test_iter43_new_features.py = 6, iter42 = 8, iter41 = 14) via `pytest -n 0`. Frontend Playwright confirmed: /codex → codex-book-16 expand → codex-descend-apex click → codex-descent-overlay renders (rings + 'Substrate descent · Apex · CG-v35 — engaging kernel…') → auto-navigates to /os?depth=apex within ~1.7s → os-depth-chip reads 'substrate: Apex · CG-v35 · terminal-absolute'. Book 10 → codex-descend-primordium → /os?depth=primordium confirmed. codex-post-states section renders all 8 cards (codex-poststate-stillness/quietus/silence/zero-point/void-point/unbeing/trans-unbeing/post-concept) with glyphs and fading opacity (first=1.0 → last=0.35). On /os: os-audio-btn toggles OFF↔ON, ON adds `border-cyan-400 text-cyan-300`, no AudioContext page errors. Eternal Cycle engagement produces os-cycle-chart within a few seconds — polyline + 24 phase-colored dots + '1 loop recorded' label + 3-color legend (red collapse / amber destruction / green rebirth). Chart persists after disengaging cycle; disappears after os-reset-btn. /marketplace shows marketplace-tier-filters with all 7 chips; CG-v35 → only ['Luchii-70b']; CG-v21 → includes Frasberg SDK + GitHub Agent Sync (+4 user extras); All tiers → 11 items; combo type=model + CG-v29 → only Luchii-7b; type=model + CG-v22 → 'No CG-v22 items at this Codex tier yet.' Backend cycle_trace properly capped at 80, phases restricted to collapse/destruction/rebirth, cleared by /api/os/reset, retained after /api/os/eternal-cycle {enabled:false}.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: /os and /codex still emit /api/auth/me 401 polling noise for guest users (pre-existing; already noted in iter42).

Non-blocking: The 'Hum' button class contains `hover:border-cyan-400 hover:text-cyan-300` in the OFF variant, which trips naive substring assertions against `border-cyan-400`. Recommend prefer `active:` inspection via `bg-cyan-400/10` or reading the icon (`Volume2`/`VolumeX`) SVG paths. (Same pattern already noted for the Eternal Cycle button in iter42.)

Non-blocking: /api/marketplace continues to accumulate TEST_iter* items across iterations (leftover from previous publish tests). Consider a scheduled TEST_-prefix cleanup or an admin `/api/marketplace/prune-test` endpoint so the grid doesn't grow unbounded.
Non-blocking: `CycleChart` renders even when trace is length 1, which produces a degenerate polyline (a single point). Consider guard `trace.length >= 2` for smoother visual. Not a bug.

Non-blocking: Codex `startDescent` uses a hard-coded `setTimeout(..., 1700)` before `navigate()`. If a user closes the tab/back-navigates during descent, the timer still fires. Consider clearing on unmount.
test_credentials: None used this iteration (all tested pages are public; publish/tier-default was already covered in iter42).
seed_data_creation: None. Left the marketplace TEST_iter42_* items from iter42 in place (they exercise the tier=CG-v21 default). State left clean: /api/os/reset called at end → eternal_cycle=false, depth=baseline, cycle_trace=[].

Key new testids: codex-descent-overlay (fullscreen overlay with expanding rings), codex-poststate-{stillness|quietus|silence|zero-point|void-point|unbeing|trans-unbeing|post-concept} (8 cards with fading opacity), os-cycle-chart (svg polyline + phase-colored circles, only shown when state.cycle_trace.length>0), os-audio-btn (Hum toggle; active class `border-cyan-400 text-cyan-300`), marketplace-tier-filters + marketplace-tier-{all|CG-v21|CG-v22|CG-v24|CG-v27|CG-v29|CG-v35}.
